# Support

1. Read the [README](https://github.com/newdave/cloudplow/blob/master/README.md). Every setting is documented there,
   and the [changelog](https://github.com/newdave/cloudplow/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) lists what this fork changed
   from upstream, including removed settings.
2. Check the log (`cloudplow.log`, or run with `--loglevel=DEBUG`).
3. Search the [issues](https://github.com/newdave/cloudplow/issues), including closed ones.
4. If you are still stuck, [open an issue](https://github.com/newdave/cloudplow/issues/new/choose).

For questions about upstream Cloudplow that this fork has not changed, see
[l3uddz/cloudplow](https://github.com/l3uddz/cloudplow).
